description.value: The Rack Bistro is a West Coast-inspired bistro with two locations in Greater Victoria — Langford and Saanich — built around fresh, locally-sourced ingredients in a cozy, rustic setting. The Saanich location on Cedar Hill Cross Road is the newer of the two, opened by owner Cole Byers alongside wife Jasmine and Chef Rel. An all-day menu of West Coast favourites with a family-friendly atmosphere makes it a solid sit-down option for cyclists in the Victoria area.

address.value: 1550 Cedar Hill Cross Road, Victoria, V8P 2P4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record references the Saanich location of The Rack Bistro (1550 Cedar Hill Cross Road, Victoria), but the website's contact page lists the Langford location's details (2345 Millstream Rd, Langford; (778) 432 3434), which differ from the OSM phone (+1-250-472-0047) and address — Saanich-specific contact info is not published on the site. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('We provide dine in and takeout. To place an order for takeout, please call us.'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
